newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae says Jamie Gorelick vice chair.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae says Jamie Gorelick vice chair.

text.p: Fannie Mae said Wednesday Jamie Gorelick was appointed vice chair and member of the board of directors.
The company said the job has been open since September 1996, when Franklin Raines resigned to become director of the Office of Management and Budget.

Gorelick was previously deputy Attorney General of the United States, the second ranking official in the Department of Justice and the chief operating officer of the department. Fannie Mae is a congressionally chartered, shareholder-owned company that provides funds for home mortgages.
